props.name: bulkActionButtons
props.comment:
Bulk-action children rendered in the selection toolbar. `false` (default)
disables selection entirely, so pass your own bulk children (or a
`bulkActionsToolbar`) to turn selection on.

props.name: bulkActionsToolbar
props.comment: A fully custom selection toolbar, overriding `bulkActionButtons`.

props.name: defaultHiddenColumns
props.comment: Ids of the columns hidden until a choice is stored.

props.name: expand
props.comment:
Element or function component rendered as the expand panel under each row.
When provided, a chevron toggle column is added at the start of every row.

props.name: expandSingle
props.comment: Expanding a row collapses any previously-expanded one. Default `false`.

props.name: hover
props.comment: Disable row hover highlighting. Default `true` (hover on).

props.name: isRowExpandable
props.comment: Predicate deciding whether a given record can be expanded.

props.name: rowClick
props.type: string | false | (record: TRecord, id: Identifier) => string | false
props.comment:
Row-click action: `"edit"` (default) | `"show"` | `"expand"` |
`"toggleSelection"` | `false` | a path string | `(record, id) => …`.

props.name: size
props.comment: Row density. `"small"` tightens cell padding; `"medium"` (default) is standard.

props.name: storeKey
props.comment:
Store key prefix for the hidden, ordered and published columns. Default
`"<resource>.datatable"`.
